name: guardian
title: Guardian
description: Lock input, prevent sleep, keep agents running. Control the guardian macOS CLI from Raycast.
author: kilogramirisok

commands.name: status
commands.title: Guardian Status
commands.description: Show guardian lock status in menu bar

commands.name: lock
commands.title: Lock Input
commands.description: Lock all keyboard and mouse input

commands.name: wrap
commands.title: Wrap Command
commands.description: Lock input and run a command

commands.name: open-logs
commands.title: Open Guardian Logs
commands.description: View recent guardian output in terminal

commands.name: install
commands.title: Install Guardian CLI
commands.description: Install the guardian CLI via Homebrew (brew install kilogramirisok/guardian/guardian)

preferences.name: guardianPath
preferences.title: Guardian Binary Path
preferences.description: Path to guardian binary (default: auto-detect via which/brew)
